data.body:
[P1] Reject missing NESTED containers for recorded terminal branches

When ReplayChildren history was produced in FLAT mode, terminal branches have no container checkpoint. After changing to NESTED, this validation accepts `None`; because the completion record marks the branch terminal, the method subsequently returns a STARTED item without executing the branch, so inner parent validation never runs. Replay can continue with a different `BatchResult` instead of failing as nondeterministic. In NESTED mode, require an existing terminal container checkpoint here and add FLAT→NESTED map/parallel ReplayChildren tests.
